name: Resolume Arena / Avenue
notes: REST/WebSocket actions are registered in src/actions/<area>/<area>Actions.ts, one file per action; the registry key (for example triggerClip) differs from the factory name (connectClip) in some cases. The catalog uses the registry key.
Layer, column, clip, deck and layer group positions are text inputs with useVariables and Regex.NUMBER, not dropdowns; indices are 1-based.
Actions starting with osc work over OSC only; the other actions need the REST/WebSocket connection and fall back to OSC only where the source implements it (for example triggerClip, selectClip).
Effect actions come in five scopes (layer, clip, clipList, group, composition); the effect and parameter dropdowns are filled from the running composition and are listed as dynamic choices.
layerActions.ts also registers bypassLayerGroup (imported from the layer-group folder); the same key is registered in layerGroupActions.ts with the same factory.
Built on @companion-module/base ~1.10.0: no expressions; variables only through useVariables text inputs.
